Package planning

Class AStarPlanner

java.lang.Object
planning.AStarPlanner
All Implemented Interfaces:
Planner
public class AStarPlanner extends Object implements Planner
AStarPlanner is an A* search algorithm implementation for the Blocks World problem. It finds an optimal plan to achieve a target configuration of blocks from an initial configuration, given a set of actions and a heuristic function. In this Blocks World context, each state represents a configuration of blocks, and each action manipulates the arrangement of the blocks. The planner can also keep track of explored nodes, and it can display the number of nodes explored if node count activation is enabled.

    • AStarPlanner

      public AStarPlanner(Map<Variable,Object> initialState, Set<Action> actions, Goal goal, Heuristic heuristic)
      Constructs an AStarPlanner for solving the Blocks World planning problem, initialized with the starting state, available actions, goal state, and heuristic function.
      Parameters:
      initialState - the initial configuration of blocks as a map of variables to their states
      actions - the set of actions available to manipulate the blocks configuration
      goal - the target configuration of blocks, represented by a Goal object
      heuristic - the heuristic function estimating the cost to reach the goal configuration

  • Method Details

    • plan

      public List<Action> plan()
      Executes the A* search algorithm to determine an optimal sequence of actions for rearranging the blocks from the initial configuration to the goal configuration. The algorithm explores states with the lowest estimated total cost (distance + heuristic) first.
      Specified by:
      plan in interface Planner
      Returns:
      a list of actions representing the optimal plan to achieve the goal configuration, or null if no plan is found.
